title: Heart failure: type, acuity and hypertension
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's heart failure and any related hypertension.
note:
Chief Complaint
Routine follow-up for heart failure.

HPI
The patient is an 89-year-old woman who presents today for a scheduled follow-up regarding her chronic diastolic heart failure. She reports that she has been feeling well and denies any shortness of breath, increased fatigue, or significant swelling in her lower extremities over the past month. She states that she is managing her symptoms effectively at home and feels stable. She reports good adherence to her current medication regimen and denies any side effects.

Medication List
Furosemide 40mg daily
Lisinopril 10mg daily
Spironolactone 25mg daily

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented x3. She appears in no acute distress. Her skin is warm and dry. Breath sounds are clear bilaterally and no crackles are noted. Heart sounds are regular with no murmurs. Lower extremities show no edema. Vital signs are stable: Blood pressure 128/78, Heart Rate 72, Respiratory Rate 16, Oxygen Saturation 98% on room air.

Assessment
The patient has chronic HFpEF. Her condition is currently stable with no signs of worsening.

Plan
Continue current medication regimen. Follow up in 3 months for a routine evaluation.

Electronically signed,
P. O'Brien, MD
May 14, 2026
